title: Expose Java extract-method as a code-mode java.* binding
wanted_capability: A code-mode namespace binding such as java.extractMethodCodeBlock({ file, range or oldText, methodName }) that returns edits.merge-compatible changes like java.extractClass, plus a focused java.describe contract for the transform.
fallback_used: The probe discovered and used the lower-level bbox_refactor_plan(kind="extract_java_code_block_to_method") surface instead of a java.* binding.
notes: Generic ergonomic gap: extractClass has a code-mode binding with contract text and edits payloads; extract-method currently requires the lower-level refactor-plan surface.
resolution_note: Implemented java.extractMethodCodeBlock({ file, oldText, methodName, className?, ... }) as a code-mode binding over extract_java_code_block_to_method. It returns edits.merge-compatible hash-anchored changes, supports previewOnly and operator overrides, advertises its contract through java.describe, and points planner refusals back to analysis.methodRegions for gate facts.
